<js>
var cEls = java.getElements("@css: .chaplist-box > ul > li > a");

var chapters = [];
for(let i=0; i<cEls.length; i++){
  chapters.push({
      title: cEls[i].text(),
      url: "https://m.dumanwu.com" + cEls[i].attr("href")
  });
}
var moreText = java.getElement("@css: .chaplist-box > .chaplist-more");
if(moreText ){
var url = baseUrl;
if(baseUrl.endsWith("/")){
   url = url.substring(0, url.length-1);
}
var id = url .substring(url .lastIndexOf("/")+1).split(",", 2)[0];
var map = new Packages.java.util.HashMap();
map.put("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8");
var resp = java.post("https://m.dumanwu.com/morechapter", "id="+id, map);
if(resp.statusCode() == 200){
 var body = JSON.parse(resp.body());
  if(body.code != -1){
       for(let i=0; i<body.data.length; i++){
        chapters.push({
         title: body.data[i].chaptername,
         url: `https://m.dumanwu.com/${id}/${body.data[i].chapterid}.html`
       });
     }
  } 
 }
}else{
 java.log("moreText ="+moreText );
}
chapters.reverse();
</js>
